key.name: remote-images
key.summary: Load remote images in the preview
key.description: Fetch HTTP and HTTPS images referenced by the current document. Disabled by default to prevent tracking and requests to local network services.

key.name: appearance
key.description: Follow the system preference or force light or dark mode.

key.description: Keep the editor and preview panes at the same relative scroll position.

key.name: autocomplete-links
key.description: Turn a typed [] into []() and place the cursor inside the parentheses.
